title: Check this year
nothing: The map is aligned on the CMS: nothing to report.
toAlignHelp: Tied by their territory's number: the map takes the CMS's French name and dates.
toConfirmHelp: Tied by their Wikidata id alone, which comes from Cliopatria and may be wrong: compare both names before aligning.
toEnterHelp: The CMS lacks this date: the map keeps its own, editable, until it is entered in the CMS.
untiedHelp: Neither a territory number nor a Wikidata id the CMS knows.
missingTerritory: territory no. {id} is no longer in the CMS
dateFields: {fields, select, both {beginning and end} existsFrom {beginning} existsTo {end} other {{fields}}}
cmsOffline: The CMS does not answer: start it, then try again. Nothing changed on the map.
cmsRefused: The CMS refused: {reason}. Nothing changed on the map.
cmsSignedOut: Your CMS session has expired: sign in again, then try again.
alignRefused: The map refused the alignment: nothing changed.
alignStep: {count, plural, one {align {name} on the CMS} other {align # polities on the CMS}}
